input.summary: Pass GO, lock two balls at the center ramp, start Monopoly Multiball at the right ramp, then alternate Free Parking Jackpots with railroad relights before taking Electric Company Supers.

quickInfo.name: Monopoly Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Pass GO, lock two balls at the center ramp, and start at the right ramp.

quickInfo.name: Free Parking Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: Use the upper flipper to shoot the Free Parking ramp during Monopoly Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Railroad Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Collect all four railroads, then use the railroad ramp for Jackpots.

quickInfo.name: Corner Multiballs
quickInfo.summary: Roll & Collect can start Breakout, Free Parking Multiball, or Ripoff Multiball from a corner space.

quickInfo.name: Land Grab
quickInfo.summary: Collect all eight property groups and four railroads, then use Roll & Collect to start the timed four-ball final mode.

steps.text: Test the center ramp, right ramp, railroad ramp, Electric Company, and upper-flipper Free Parking shot.
Use Roll & Collect, complete lit mode shots, and shoot railroads to move around the board. A railroad advances ten spaces. Pass GO to light a lock.
Shoot the center ramp for the first lock. Build safe railroad or Roll & Collect progress until the return is controlled, then shoot the center ramp for the second lock.
Shoot the right ramp to start Monopoly Multiball.
Use the upper flipper to shoot the Free Parking ramp for a Jackpot.
modeNotes: Monopoly Multiball Jackpot: The upper Free Parking ramp scores the Jackpot. The right railroad ramp relights it.

steps.text: Shoot the right railroad ramp to relight the Jackpot. Return to Free Parking and repeat.
After the railroad-ramp enable, shoot Electric Company for the Super Jackpot.

fallback.title: Railroad Multiball
fallback.when: Use this plan when the Bank door, center ramp, or Electric Company feed is unreliable.

steps.text: Collect all four railroads through board movement and railroad shots.
Start Railroad Multiball.
Repeat the railroad ramp for Jackpots while the return remains controlled.
Take Breakout, Free Parking Multiball, or Ripoff Multiball when Roll & Collect lands on its corner.
Collect all eight property groups and all four railroads.
Use Roll & Collect to start the timed four-ball Land Grab.
Shoot the center ramp to add houses, or make four Free Parking ramp shots during Land Grab.
Build the hotel at Electric Company. Shoot the right ramp for the next property.

techniques.name: Upper-flipper Free Parking shot
techniques.instruction: Let the ball reach the upper flipper under control. Shoot the short Free Parking ramp for the Jackpot.

cautions.issue: The Electric Company can reject or kick the ball toward danger.
cautions.response: Test the first feed under protection. Do not force the Super Jackpot after repeated rejects.

cautions.issue: The Bank door can block the center-ramp lock shot, and the railroad ramp returns quickly.
cautions.response: Confirm that the door is open before the center shot. Prepare the left flipper before each railroad return.

playfieldReferences.context: Use Roll & Collect to move around the board and start qualified features.
playfieldReferences.label: Roll & Collect saucer
playfieldReferences.description: Roll the dice, collect property, and start qualified corner or final features here.

playfieldReferences.context: Lock two balls at the center ramp.
playfieldReferences.label: Center ramp and Bank door
playfieldReferences.description: Pass the Bank door to lock balls for Monopoly Multiball.

playfieldReferences.context: Start Monopoly Multiball and advance Land Grab properties at the right ramp.
playfieldReferences.label: Right ramp
playfieldReferences.description: Start Monopoly Multiball; during Land Grab, advance to the next property.

playfieldReferences.context: Shoot the upper-flipper Free Parking ramp for Monopoly Multiball Jackpots.
playfieldReferences.label: Free Parking ramp
playfieldReferences.description: Collect Monopoly Multiball Jackpots or add one Land Grab house per shot until four are complete.

playfieldReferences.context: Shoot the railroad ramp to relight the Monopoly Jackpot.
playfieldReferences.label: Railroad ramp
playfieldReferences.description: Relight Monopoly Jackpots and collect Railroad Multiball Jackpots.

playfieldReferences.context: Shoot Electric Company for the Monopoly Super Jackpot or a Land Grab hotel.
playfieldReferences.label: Electric Company
playfieldReferences.description: Collect the Monopoly Super Jackpot or build a Land Grab hotel.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm CPU 3.02 with display 3.01; earlier code changes tournament handling, corner features, and Land Grab behavior.
Verify IFPA, PAPA, EXPO, or custom settings, plus Extra Ball conversion, Bank difficulty, Bonus X, and Electric Company difficulty.
Test the Bank door, center and right ramps, railroad return, Roll & Collect eject, Free Parking shot, and Electric Company feed.
input.simpleOverview: Monopoly uses laps around the board to pass GO, then two center-ramp locks and the right ramp start Monopoly Multiball. Alternate the upper-flipper Free Parking Jackpot with railroad-ramp relights, then shoot Electric Company for the Super Jackpot.
input.overview: Passing GO lights a center-ramp lock in Monopoly. Bank two locks and shoot the right ramp to start Monopoly Multiball, then alternate Free Parking Jackpots with railroad-ramp relights before collecting Electric Company Supers. Continue property groups and railroads toward Land Grab only alongside controlled Multiball shots.
